changes.issue: Physical alternate shape silently replaced by base geometry when its sheet had no registered variants.
changes.fix: Retain every nonzero requested shape index, keep existing range checks for registered variant tables, and require a prepared offset for every participating physical zone part. Missing geometry raises a named FloorplanError instead of substituting the base pose. Abstract packing fixtures without physical cross parts remain supported.
changes.tests: Negative, positive and large unavailable indices; full and selected-sheet estimates; ordinary and impedance net classes; valid base estimate after each rejected selection.
changes.negative_control: New test fails on original code: expected error containing no prepared geometry for U1001; 0.55s.

changes.issue: The stricter free-pass error boundary from 15f8c2b9 exposed a compatibility regression: conservative-only diagnostics intentionally threw generic FloorplanError to exclude the free pass.
changes.fix: Introduce FloorplanReservationExcluded for that explicit policy exclusion. Fixed and automatic optional-pass boundaries recover only typed packing infeasibility or typed reservation exclusion; unrelated FloorplanError failures still propagate.
changes.tests: Observer test requires the specific policy type and unchanged message before work. Fixed/automatic fixtures naturally selecting the free pass instead choose the conservative pass under explicit policy, with no free-pass callback and exact independently observed fallback receipt. Existing runtime/domain failure transport and typed packing rejection tests remain active.

limits: Focused regression suites and one construction screen per current reference, not a new full board/audit/render qualification, reproducibility campaign or performance comparison. No fallback ceilings or hardware acceptance limits changed. Experimental 165x159 carrier remains unaccepted; wider goal remains open.
